ticket.summary: Leaking braided supply line under bathroom sink; customer closed fixture shutoff, leak stopped, but it's the home's only full bathroom so water is off there.
mitigation_advice: Confirmed customer closed the fixture shutoff valve under the sink and leak stopped; keep it closed until the tech arrives [PB-01]
If leaking resumes, shut off the house main (clockwise wheel / lever perpendicular) and text back for on-call dispatch [PB-02]

quote_lines.description: Supply line replacement (braided hose, bathroom sink)

ticket.customer_message: You're all set — since it's your only bathroom, I've reserved our first priority slot: tomorrow (Mon Sept 1) at 8:00 AM. Keep that shutoff valve closed overnight; the rest of the house is fine to use [PB-01]. If anything starts leaking again before then, shut the house main [PB-02] and text back and I'll page the on-call plumber. Quote: $129 flat — SUPPLY-LINE-REPLACE (braided supply line replacement, ~45 min on site). If the tech finds the shutoff valve itself is failing, they'll quote that before doing extra work.
